$comment: Written form -> spoken form, applied to narration before text-to-speech. Captions keep the written form. Matching is case-sensitive and whole-token, longest entry first. Prefer rewording a script over adding an entry; add one when a term must appear as written.

entries.note: Said or-LEENZ, stress on the second syllable. espeak-ng reads the written form as OR-lee-unz; the hyphenated respelling phonemizes to /O:l'i:nz/.
Scripts should say 'write-ahead log'; this is the fallback reading.
